added: Experimental: calling cards can set the figures apart as Yona Appletree's Contra Card does — each move in bold dark red, the dancers in bold, and amounts such as ½ or 3 places in blue-grey, in your dialect's words. The default card layout now does this; add highlight to the figures line of a layout of your own to turn it on there.
FigureRenderer.dancerTerms: every word the renderer may print for a dancer or a role under a dialect, for display that sets dancers apart in a rendered line.
